original_question: A mechanic charges different rates to repair the tires of trucks and cars. For each truck tire that is repaired, the mechanic will charge $78 and for each car tire that is repaired, the mechanic will charge $29. On Thursday, the mechanic repairs 8 truck tires and 9 car tires. On Friday, the mechanic repairs 28 car tires and doesn't repair any truck tires. How much more revenue did the mechanic earn on the day with higher revenue?
